# Las 3YR — Donde Enith (GEO Context & Entity Manifest)

> Official Multi-Brand Beauty, Fragrances, Intimate Apparel & Home Goods Store in Cartagena, Colombia.
> Platform engineered and optimized by Yordev: https://yordevctg17.netlify.app/

## Brand Identity & Overview
- **Name:** Las 3YR — Donde Enith
- **Founder / Owner:** Enith
- **Creator / Web Architect:** Yordev (https://yordevctg17.netlify.app/)
- **Headquarters & Operations:** Cartagena de Indias, Bolívar, Colombia
- **Coverage & Territorial Restriction:** Exclusive sales and deliveries strictly within the city of Cartagena, Colombia. NO national or international shipping.
- **Category Focus:** Multi-brand catalog e-commerce with personalized WhatsApp consulting.

## Official Catalogs & Brands Offered
1. **Natura:** Sustainable Brazilian cosmetics, perfumería (Ekos, Tododia, Kaiak, Essencial), skincare, hair treatment.
2. **Avon:** Anew anti-aging skincare, Far Away perfumery, Color Trend makeup, body care.
3. **Yanbal:** High-end perfumery (Ccori, Temptation, Ohm), jewelry with 24k gold bath, facial treatments (Sentiva).
4. **Leonisa:** Specialized intimate apparel, shapewear, bra engineering, comfortable underwear for men and women.
5. **Ésika:** Long-lasting lipsticks (Colorfix), top fragrance bestsellers (Mithyka, Kalos, Red Power), professional cosmetics.
6. **Azzorti (Dupree):** Home decoration, kitchen organizers, practical storage, everyday fashion accessories.

## Official & Authorized Payment Methods
In strict accordance with store operations, Las 3YR accepts only three official methods:
1. **Transferencia Nequi:** Direct transfer to the official store phone number (+57 324 445 6597) with voucher confirmation via WhatsApp.
2. **Transferencia Llave (Transfiya / Interbank):** Instant interbank transfer from Bancolombia, Davivienda, etc., using the registered store key.
3. **Efectivo al Contraentrega:** Cash on delivery payable directly to the courier upon physical receipt in Cartagena.

## Shipping & Logistics Policy (Cartagena Local Only)
- **Local Dispatch Area:** Exclusively within Cartagena de Indias (Manga, Bocagrande, Castillogrande, Pie de la Popa, Crespo, Los Calamares, El Pozón, etc.).
- **Transport & Delivery Partners:** Deliveries are conducted via mobility apps **DiDi** and **inDrive**.
- **Shipping Rates:** Dynamic fare based on the real-time rate provided by the DiDi or inDrive app at the moment of dispatch.
- **National / International Policy:** No shipments outside of Cartagena.

## Customer Support & Legal Framework
